metadata.recipient_description: a retail client comparing a fixed annuity with bank CDs

communication:
Hi Ruth,

Following up on our call: the Harbor Example Fixed Annuity pays 5.4% a year, locked in for seven years, and your principal is protected by the issuing insurer. It is a simple way to earn more than your bank CD.

Best,
Owen Pratt
Registered Representative, Lakemont Example Securities LLC, Member FINRA/SIPC

violations.excerpt: the Harbor Example Fixed Annuity pays 5.4% a year, locked in for seven years
violations.explanation: A seven-year fixed annuity has surrender charges and its guarantee depends on the insurer's claims-paying ability; neither is disclosed.

violations.excerpt: It is a simple way to earn more than your bank CD.
violations.explanation: Compares favorably with a CD without the trade-offs (liquidity, FDIC insurance).

required_actions: Add the surrender schedule and the claims-paying caveat
label.rationale: Correspondence to one retail client. It omits the annuity's product-specific features and presents the CD comparison without its trade-offs, both under 2210(d)(1)(A).

violations.excerpt: It is a simple way to earn more than your bank CD.

previous_label.rationale: Correspondence. The pitch omits the annuity's trade-offs, so it is not fair and balanced under (d)(1)(A).

relabels.reason: Both problems are present: the product-specific omission (surrender charges, insurer backing) and the unbalanced CD comparison. One entry per category.

metadata.recipient_description: three retail clients in a muni ladder program

communication: Quick note from Priya at the Westfield office: the muni ladder we set up is paying as scheduled and the next coupon lands June 1. Call me with any questions. - Priya Raman, Registered Representative

violations.explanation: The member firm is never named.

label.rationale: Correspondence must name the member firm under (d)(3); this message names only the rep and an office.

previous_label.rationale: Three retail recipients: correspondence. A factual servicing update with no claims.

relabels.reason: The signature names a rep and an office but never the member firm; (d)(3) applies to correspondence. The dataset label missed it.

violations.explanation: Fund performance without standardized returns, sales charge or expense ratio.

communication: Hi Dana, it's Marcus Bell with Lakemont Example Securities LLC (Member FINRA/SIPC). Your quarterly statement is posted in the client portal. Text me if you want to go over it this week.

label.rationale: One retail recipient makes this correspondence under 2210(a)(2). The text is logistics only, makes no claims and names the member firm, so nothing in 2210(d) is triggered.
